test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Cissy promised __to turn over a new leaf__ and keep her room clean from now on.

options.text: To start behaving in a better way

solution:
The correct answer is **'To start behaving in a better way'.**
